mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.25% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 6.0% for three consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE < 6.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-mo MA and HOUST > 12-mo MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average for four consecutive months signals improving industrial production and economic output, which supports higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 6-mo MA for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when INDPRO remains above its 6-month moving average for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 and RSAFS below their 6-month moving averages for two months indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 6-mo MA and RSAFS < 6-mo MA for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are below their 6-month moving averages for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.50 percentage points signals an aggressive tightening stance, which rapidly raises borrowing costs and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative after a one-month FEDFUNDS increase greater than 0.50%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average while UNRATE remains below 6.0% for three months indicates labor market expansion without wage inflation, supporting corporate margins and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-mo MA and UNRATE < 6.0% for three months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average and UNRATE is below 6.0% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive relationship exists between HOUST above its 3-month moving average and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns, reflecting housing market strength as a leading indicator of consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average in more than 60% of instances over a 5-year period.
